title: Build a Diffusion Model from Scratch
blurb: Write every piece of a denoising diffusion model in NumPy: the noise schedule, the forward process, a small time-conditioned denoiser, the training loss, and the DDPM, DDIM and ODE samplers. The last sections connect it to score matching and flow matching and finish with a complete train-and-sample loop.
prereq: Comfort with NumPy broadcasting and the basic properties of the normal distribution (sums, scaling, mean and variance) is enough to start.
next: Scale the toy pieces into a real PyTorch model trained on images, then explore latent diffusion, distillation for few-step sampling, and text conditioning with cross-attention.
